      function configuredAuthMode(value) {

      function scanShape(value, seen = new Set()) {
        if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || seen.has(value)) return;

      function exactObject(value, keys, label) {
        assert(value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value), `${label} must be an object`);

      function exactObjectWithOptional(value, keys, optionalKeys, label) {
        assert(value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value), `${label} must be an object`);

        const optional = new Set(optionalKeys);
        const actual = Object.keys(value);

      function safeText(value, optional = false) {

      }
      function timestamp(value, quarterHour = false) {
        if (typeof value !== "string") return false;

      function validateRange(value) {

      function validateActual(point, uniqueId, range, previous) {

          assert(value.series.every((series) => series.status === value.system.state && series.model_name === null && !series.actual.length && !series.forecast.length), "empty station series invalid");
        } else {
          assert(value.system.generated_at !== null && value.system.state !== "error", "full station system invalid");
          assert(value.system.state !== "ready" || value.readiness === null || value.readiness.remaining_days === 0, "ready station readiness invalid");
          const times = value.series.flatMap((series) => series.actual.map((point) => point.data_time));

      function dateTime(value) {
        if (value === null) return "—";

          SHANGHAI_DATE_TIME.formatToParts(date)
            .filter((part) => part.type !== "literal")
            .map((part) => [part.type, part.value]),
        );
        return `${parts.year}/${parts.month}/${parts.day} ${parts.hour}:${parts.minute}`;
      }
      function timeOnly(value) {
        const formatted = dateTime(value);
        return formatted === "—" ? formatted : formatted.slice(-5);

      function axisDateTime(value) {
        const formatted = dateTime(value);

      function svgNode(name, attributes = {}) {
        const node = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, name);
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) node.setAttribute(key, String(value));
        return node;

      function buildPath(points, x, y, timeField) {
        let drawing = false;
        const commands = [];
        for (const point of points) {
          if (point.value === null) { drawing = false; continue; }
          commands.push(`${drawing ? "L" : "M"} ${x(point[timeField]).toFixed(2)} ${y(point.value).toFixed(2)}`);
          drawing = true;
        }
        return commands.join(" ");
      }

      function chartPoints(points, maximum = 1200) {
        if (points.length <= maximum) return points;
        const step = Math.ceil((points.length - 1) / (maximum - 1));
        const sampled = [];
        for (let index = 0; index < points.length; index += step) sampled.push(points[index]);
        if (sampled.at(-1) !== points.at(-1)) sampled.push(points.at(-1));
        return sampled;
      }

      function renderChart(section, series, range) {
        const svg = section.querySelector(series.unique_id === "station_total_load" ? ".load-chart" : ".soc-chart");
        const viewport = svg.closest(".chart-viewport");
        let tooltip = viewport.querySelector(".chart-tooltip");
        if (tooltip === null) {
          tooltip = document.createElement("div");
          tooltip.className = "chart-tooltip";
          tooltip.hidden = true;
          viewport.append(tooltip);
        }
        tooltip.hidden = true;
        svg.onpointermove = null;
        svg.onpointerleave = null;
        svg.replaceChildren();
        const title = svgNode("title");
        text(title, `${section.querySelector("h2").textContent}${SERIES_LABELS[series.unique_id]}同时间轴趋势`);
        const description = svgNode("desc");
        text(description, "实线为已获得实绩，虚线为预测值，两者使用相同目标时间刻度。");
        svg.append(title, description);
        if (!range.history_start || (!series.actual.length && !series.forecast.length)) return;
        const width = 1180, height = 250, left = 54, right = 22, top = 24, bottom = 38;
        const start = milliseconds(range.history_start), end = milliseconds(range.forecast_end);
        const values = [...series.actual, ...series.forecast].map((point) => point.value).filter(finite);
        if (!values.length) return;
        let minimum = series.unique_id === "storage_soc" ? 0 : Math.min(...values);
        let maximum = series.unique_id === "storage_soc" ? 100 : Math.max(...values);
        if (minimum === maximum) { minimum -= 1; maximum += 1; }
        const padding = series.unique_id === "storage_soc" ? 0 : (maximum - minimum) * .1;
        minimum = Math.max(series.unique_id === "station_total_load" ? 0 : minimum, minimum - padding);
        maximum += padding;
        const x = (time) => {
          const instant = finite(time) ? time : milliseconds(time);
          assert(Number.isFinite(instant), "chart timestamp invalid");
          return left + (instant - start) / (end - start) * (width - left - right);
        };
        const y = (value) => top + (maximum - value) / (maximum - minimum) * (height - top - bottom);
        for (let index = 0; index <= 4; index += 1) {
          const yy = top + index / 4 * (height - top - bottom);
          svg.append(svgNode("line", { x1: left, y1: yy, x2: width - right, y2: yy, class: "grid-line" }));
          const label = svgNode("text", { x: left - 7, y: yy + 3, "text-anchor": "end", class: "axis-label" });
          text(label, (maximum - index / 4 * (maximum - minimum)).toFixed(series.unique_id === "storage_soc" ? 0 : 0));
          svg.append(label);
        }
        for (let index = 0; index <= 4; index += 1) {
          const tickTime = start + index / 4 * (end - start);
          const label = svgNode("text", {
            x: left + index / 4 * (width - left - right),
            y: height - 10,
            "text-anchor": index === 0 ? "start" : index === 4 ? "end" : "middle",
            class: "axis-label",
          });
          text(label, axisDateTime(new Date(tickTime).toISOString()));
          svg.append(label);
        }
        const dividerX = x(range.now_separator);
        svg.append(svgNode("line", { x1: dividerX, y1: top, x2: dividerX, y2: height - bottom, class: "now-divider", "data-kind": "current-divider" }));
        const actualPath = buildPath(chartPoints(series.actual), x, y, "data_time");
        if (actualPath) svg.append(svgNode("path", { d: actualPath, class: "chart-line", "data-kind": "actual", "data-series": series.unique_id }));
        const forecastPath = buildPath(chartPoints(series.forecast), x, y, "target_time");
        if (forecastPath) svg.append(svgNode("path", { d: forecastPath, class: "chart-line", "data-kind": "forecast", "data-series": series.unique_id }));

        const samplesByTime = new Map();
        series.actual.forEach((point) => {
          const time = milliseconds(point.data_time);
          if (Number.isFinite(time)) samplesByTime.set(time, { time, actual: point.value, forecast: null });
        });
        series.forecast.forEach((point) => {
          const time = milliseconds(point.target_time);
          if (!Number.isFinite(time)) return;
          const sample = samplesByTime.get(time) || { time, actual: null, forecast: null };
          sample.forecast = point.value;
          samplesByTime.set(time, sample);
        });
        const samples = Array.from(samplesByTime.values()).sort((leftSample, rightSample) => leftSample.time - rightSample.time);
        if (!samples.length) return;
        const hoverLine = svgNode("line", { x1: left, y1: top, x2: left, y2: height - bottom, class: "chart-hover-line" });
        hoverLine.style.visibility = "hidden";
        svg.append(hoverLine);
        const hideTooltip = () => {
          tooltip.hidden = true;
          hoverLine.style.visibility = "hidden";
        };
        svg.onpointermove = (event) => {
          const bounds = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (bounds.width <= 0) return hideTooltip();
          const svgX = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width * width;
          if (svgX < left || svgX > width - right) return hideTooltip();
          const targetTime = start + (svgX - left) / (width - left - right) * (end - start);
          let low = 0;
          let high = samples.length - 1;
          while (low < high) {
            const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
            if (samples[middle].time < targetTime) low = middle + 1;
            else high = middle;
          }
          let sample = samples[low];
          if (low > 0 && Math.abs(samples[low - 1].time - targetTime) <= Math.abs(sample.time - targetTime)) sample = samples[low - 1];
          const sampleX = x(sample.time);
          hoverLine.setAttribute("x1", sampleX.toFixed(2));
          hoverLine.setAttribute("x2", sampleX.toFixed(2));
          hoverLine.style.visibility = "visible";
          text(tooltip, `${dateTime(new Date(sample.time).toISOString())}\n实际：${valueText(series.unique_id, sample.actual)}\n预测：${valueText(series.unique_id, sample.forecast)}`);
          const viewportBounds = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
          const visibleX = event.clientX - viewportBounds.left;
          tooltip.style.left = `${viewport.scrollLeft + visibleX}px`;
          tooltip.classList.toggle("align-right", visibleX > viewport.clientWidth * .68);
          tooltip.hidden = false;
        };
        svg.onpointerleave = hideTooltip;
      }

          const result = Object.create(null);

          return result;

          if (Object.keys(customRunIds).length === 0) sessionStorage.removeItem(RUN_STORAGE_KEY);
          else sessionStorage.setItem(RUN_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(customRunIds));
        } catch (_error) { /* persistence is best effort */ }
      }

      function validateCustomRun(value) {
        const fields = [
          "run_id", "station_id", "status", "history_start", "history_end", "history_days",
          "forecast_start", "forecast_end", "forecast_days", "interval_seconds", "points_per_day",
          "expected_points_per_series", "model_policy", "model_manifest", "source_manifest", "error_code",
          "started_at", "completed_at", "evaluated_at", "created_at", "updated_at",
        ];
        exactObjectWithOptional(value, fields, ["model_manifest", "source_manifest"], "custom run");
        const run = {
          ...value,
          model_manifest: Object.hasOwn(value, "model_manifest") ? value.model_manifest : null,
          source_manifest: Object.hasOwn(value, "source_manifest") ? value.source_manifest : null,
        };
        assert(/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$/.test(run.run_id) && safeText(run.station_id), "custom run identity invalid");
        assert(Object.hasOwn(CUSTOM_RUN_LABELS, run.status), "custom run status invalid");
        ["history_start", "history_end", "forecast_start", "forecast_end", "created_at", "updated_at"].forEach((field) => assert(timestamp(run[field]), `custom run ${field} invalid`));
        ["started_at", "completed_at", "evaluated_at"].forEach((field) => assert(run[field] === null || timestamp(run[field]), `custom run ${field} invalid`));
        assert(integer(run.history_days, 7, 90) && integer(run.forecast_days, 1, 7), "custom run day range invalid");
        assert(ALLOWED_INTERVALS.includes(run.interval_seconds), "custom run interval invalid");
        assert(run.points_per_day === 86400 / run.interval_seconds, "custom run daily points invalid");
        assert(run.expected_points_per_series === run.points_per_day * run.forecast_days, "custom run point count invalid");
        assert(milliseconds(run.history_end) - milliseconds(run.history_start) === run.history_days * 86400000, "custom run history window invalid");
        assert(run.history_end === run.forecast_start && milliseconds(run.forecast_end) - milliseconds(run.forecast_start) === run.forecast_days * 86400000, "custom run forecast window invalid");
        assert(run.model_policy === (run.history_days < 28 ? "seasonal_naive_only" : "full_selection"), "custom run model policy invalid");
        assert(run.error_code === null || safeText(run.error_code), "custom run error invalid");
        assert(run.model_manifest === null || (typeof run.model_manifest === "object" && !Array.isArray(run.model_manifest)), "custom model manifest invalid");
        assert(run.source_manifest === null || (typeof run.source_manifest === "object" && !Array.isArray(run.source_manifest)), "custom source manifest invalid");
        return run;
      }

      function validateCustomResult(value) {
        scanShape(value);
        exactObject(value, ["run", "series"], "custom result");
        const run = validateCustomRun(value.run);
        assert(["succeeded", "evaluated"].includes(run.status), "custom result is not terminal");
        assert(Array.isArray(value.series) && value.series.length === 2, "custom result series count invalid");
        value.series.forEach((series, seriesIndex) => {
          exactObject(series, ["unique_id", "unit", "model_name", "points"], "custom result series");
          assert(series.unique_id === SERIES_IDS[seriesIndex] && series.unit === SERIES_UNITS[series.unique_id] && safeText(series.model_name), "custom result series identity invalid");
          assert(Array.isArray(series.points) && series.points.length === run.expected_points_per_series, "custom result point count invalid");
          series.points.forEach((point, pointIndex) => {
            exactObject(point, ["target_time", "horizon_step", "forecast_value", "actual_value", "actual_quality", "absolute_percentage_error"], "custom result point");
            assert(instantTimestamp(point.target_time), "custom result timestamp invalid");
            assert(point.horizon_step === pointIndex + 1, "custom result horizon invalid");
            assert(milliseconds(point.target_time) === milliseconds(run.forecast_start) + pointIndex * run.interval_seconds * 1000, "custom result continuity invalid");
            assert(finite(point.forecast_value), "custom forecast value invalid");
            assert(series.unique_id === "station_total_load" ? point.forecast_value >= 0 : point.forecast_value >= 0 && point.forecast_value <= 100, "custom forecast physical range invalid");
            assert(point.actual_quality === null || ["valid", "invalid"].includes(point.actual_quality), "custom actual quality invalid");
            assert(point.actual_quality === "valid" ? finite(point.actual_value) : point.actual_value === null, "custom actual value invalid");
            assert(point.absolute_percentage_error === null || finite(point.absolute_percentage_error) && point.absolute_percentage_error >= 0, "custom APE invalid");
          });
        });
        return { ...value, run };
      }

      function validateCustomPerformance(value) {
        scanShape(value);
        exactObject(value, ["station_id", "lookback_days", "interval_seconds", "forecast_days", "model_policy", "calculated_at", "series"], "custom performance");
        assert(safeText(value.station_id) && value.lookback_days === 7 && ALLOWED_INTERVALS.includes(value.interval_seconds), "custom performance identity invalid");
        assert(integer(value.forecast_days, 1, 7) && ["seasonal_naive_only", "full_selection"].includes(value.model_policy) && timestamp(value.calculated_at), "custom performance config invalid");
        assert(Array.isArray(value.series) && value.series.length === 2, "custom performance series count invalid");
        value.series.forEach((series, index) => {
          exactObject(series, ["unique_id", "mape_percent", "baseline_mape_percent", "relative_baseline_improvement_percent", "scorable_point_count", "run_count"], "custom performance series");
          assert(series.unique_id === SERIES_IDS[index] && integer(series.scorable_point_count, 0) && integer(series.run_count, 0), "custom performance series invalid");
          ["mape_percent", "baseline_mape_percent", "relative_baseline_improvement_percent"].forEach((field) => assert(series[field] === null || finite(series[field]), `custom performance ${field} invalid`));
        });
        return value;
      }

      async function customRequest(path, options = {}) {
        if (authMode !== "server_token" && (authMode !== "postmessage" || apiToken === null)) throw new Error("custom gateway unavailable");
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), options.timeout || 30_000);
        try {
          const headers = { Accept: "application/json" };
          if (authMode === "postmessage") headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${apiToken}`;
          if (options.body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
          const response = await fetch(path, {
            method: options.method || "GET",
            cache: "no-store",
            redirect: "error",
            referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
            credentials: "omit",
            headers,
            body: options.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.body),
            signal: controller.signal,
          });
          if (response.status === 401 && authMode === "postmessage") {
            requestAuthentication();
            const error = new Error("登录状态已失效");
            error.name = "M3AuthError";
            throw error;
          }
          const declaredSize = Number(response.headers.get("content-length") || 0);
          if (declaredSize > 16 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("预测结果过大");
          const raw = await response.text();
          if (new TextEncoder().encode(raw).byteLength > 16 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("预测结果过大");
          let envelope;
          try { envelope = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_error) { throw new Error("预测服务返回不正确"); }
          scanShape(envelope);
          if (!response.ok) {
            const code = envelope && envelope.error && safeText(envelope.error.code, true) ? envelope.error.code : null;
            const labels = { invalid_request: "任务参数无效", unauthorized: "登录状态无效", conflict: "同一任务标识与参数冲突", job_capacity_exceeded: "当前预测任务较多，请稍后重试", not_found: "预测任务不存在" };
            throw new Error(labels[code] || "预测服务暂不可用");
          }
          exactObject(envelope, ["status", "data"], "custom response envelope");
          assert(envelope.status === "ok", "custom response status invalid");
          return envelope.data;
        } finally {
          window.clearTimeout(timeout);
        }
      }

      function setCustomBusy(busy, label = null) {
        customBusy = busy;
        text(runButton, busy ? "处理中…" : "开始预测");
        if (label !== null) text(taskState, label);
        updateTaskConfiguration();
      }

      function newIdempotencyKey(stationKey) {
        return `ui-${stationKey}-${Date.now()}-${newAuthNonce()}`;
      }

      function stopCustomPolling() {
        selectedPollRunId = null;
        if (customPollTimer !== null) window.clearTimeout(customPollTimer);
        customPollTimer = null;
      }

      function scheduleCustomPoll(stationKey, runId) {
        stopCustomPolling();
        selectedPollRunId = runId;
        customPollTimer = window.setTimeout(() => { void pollCustomRun(stationKey, runId); }, 2_000);
      }

      async function pollCustomRun(stationKey, runId) {
        if (disposed || stationPicker.value !== stationKey || selectedPollRunId !== runId) return;
        try {
          const run = validateCustomRun(await customRequest(`${CUSTOM_RUN_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`));
          await handleCustomRun(stationKey, run);
        } catch (error) {
          setCustomBusy(false, error instanceof Error ? error.message : "预测任务查询失败");
          renderRefreshError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "预测任务查询失败");
        }
      }

      async function handleCustomRun(stationKey, run) {
        text(taskState, CUSTOM_RUN_LABELS[run.status]);
        if (run.status === "failed") {
          stopCustomPolling();
          setCustomBusy(false, `预测失败 · ${run.error_code || "internal_error"}`);
          return;
        }
        if (["queued", "running"].includes(run.status)) {
          setCustomBusy(true, CUSTOM_RUN_LABELS[run.status]);
          scheduleCustomPoll(stationKey, run.run_id);
          return;
        }
        if (loadEvidenceFor(run) === null) {
          stopCustomPolling();
          clearStoredRunId(stationKey);
          setCustomBusy(false, INCOMPATIBLE_RUN_MESSAGE);
          renderRefreshError(INCOMPATIBLE_RUN_MESSAGE);
          return;
        }
        stopCustomPolling();
        setCustomBusy(true, "正在读取预测结果");
        const query = new URLSearchParams({
          interval_seconds: String(run.interval_seconds),
          forecast_days: String(run.forecast_days),
          history_days: String(run.history_days),
        });
        const [resultValue, performanceValue] = await Promise.all([
          customRequest(`${CUSTOM_RUN_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(run.run_id)}/result`, { timeout: 60_000 }),
          customRequest(`${CUSTOM_PERFORMANCE_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(stationKey)}?${query}`),
        ]);
        const result = validateCustomResult(resultValue);
        const performance = validateCustomPerformance(performanceValue);
        const rendered = { stationKey, result, performance };
        customResults.set(stationKey, rendered);
        if (stationPicker.value === stationKey) renderCustomResult(rendered);
        setCustomBusy(false, CUSTOM_RUN_LABELS[run.status]);
      }

      async function startCustomForecast() {
        const configuration = taskConfiguration();
        if (configuration === null || customBusy || (authMode !== "server_token" && (authMode !== "postmessage" || apiToken === null))) {
          updateRunAvailability(configuration);
          return;
        }
        const stationKey = stationPicker.value;
        setCustomBusy(true, "正在提交任务");
        errorState.hidden = true;
        try {
          const run = validateCustomRun(await customRequest(`${CUSTOM_RUN_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(stationKey)}`, {
            method: "POST",
            timeout: 30_000,
            body: {
              history_start: configuration.history_start,
              history_end: configuration.history_end,
              forecast_days: configuration.forecast_days,
              interval_seconds: configuration.interval_seconds,
              idempotency_key: newIdempotencyKey(stationKey),
            },
          }));
          storeRunId(stationKey, run.run_id);
          await handleCustomRun(stationKey, run);
        } catch (error) {
          const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "预测任务提交失败";
          stopCustomPolling();
          setCustomBusy(false, message);
          renderRefreshError(message);
        }
      }

      async function resumeSelectedRun() {
        const stationKey = stationPicker.value;
        const runId = customRunIds[stationKey];
        if (!runId || customBusy || (authMode !== "server_token" && (authMode !== "postmessage" || apiToken === null))) return;
        const cached = customResults.get(stationKey);
        if (cached && cached.result.run.run_id === runId) {
          renderCustomResult(cached);
          return;
        }
        try {
          const run = validateCustomRun(await customRequest(`${CUSTOM_RUN_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`));
          await handleCustomRun(stationKey, run);
        } catch (error) {
          text(taskState, error instanceof Error ? error.message : "历史任务恢复失败");
        }
      }

      function objectValue(value) {
        return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : null;
      }

      function loadEvidenceFor(run) {
        const manifest = objectValue(run.model_manifest);
        if (manifest === null || manifest.selection_policy !== LOAD_SELECTION_POLICY) return null;
        const series = objectValue(manifest.series);
        const load = series === null ? null : objectValue(series.station_total_load);
        if (load === null || !safeText(load.model_name)) return null;
        const source = objectValue(run.source_manifest);
        const sourceSeries = source === null ? null : objectValue(source.series);
        const sourceLoad = sourceSeries === null ? null : objectValue(sourceSeries.station_total_load);
        const usableWeeks = sourceLoad?.usable_week_count;
        return {
          load,
          usableWeeks: Number.isInteger(usableWeeks) && usableWeeks >= 0 ? usableWeeks : null,
          candidateScores: Array.isArray(load.candidate_scores) ? load.candidate_scores : [],
        };
      }

      function customReadinessFor(run) {
        const source = objectValue(run.source_manifest);
        const series = source === null ? null : objectValue(source.series);
        if (series === null) return null;
        const availableDays = [];
        for (const uniqueId of SERIES_IDS) {
          const evidence = objectValue(series[uniqueId]);
          if (evidence === null) return null;
          const retained = evidence.retained_points;
          const imputed = evidence.imputed_points;
          if (!integer(retained, 0) || !integer(imputed, 0, retained)) return null;
          availableDays.push((retained - imputed) / run.points_per_day);
        }
        const available = Math.round(Math.min(28, ...availableDays) * 10) / 10;
        return {
          required_days: 28,
          available_days: available,
          remaining_days: Math.round(Math.max(0, 28 - available) * 10) / 10,
        };
      }

      function candidateScoreByName(scores, modelName) {
        return scores.find((score) => objectValue(score)?.model_name === modelName) || null;
      }

      function nonnegativeMetric(value) {
        return finite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
      }

      function percentMetric(value) {
        const number = nonnegativeMetric(value);
        return number === null ? "—" : `${metric(number)}%`;
      }

      function safeSkipReason(value) {
        return typeof value === "string" && Object.hasOwn(LOAD_SKIP_REASON_LABELS, value)
          ? LOAD_SKIP_REASON_LABELS[value]
          : "候选不可用";
      }

      function setComparisonBars(current, baseline) {
        const maximum = Math.max(current || 0, baseline || 0, 1);
        root.querySelector(".model-bar").style.width = current === null
          ? "0%"
          : `${Math.min(100, current / maximum * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
        root.querySelector(".baseline-bar").style.width = baseline === null
          ? "0%"
          : `${Math.min(100, baseline / maximum * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
      }

      function realizedLoadPresentation(evidence, resultModelName) {
        if (evidence === null || evidence.load.realized_model_name !== resultModelName) {
          return { status: "ok", fallbackReason: null };
        }
        const status = Object.hasOwn(SERIES_STATE_LABELS, evidence.load.realized_status)
          ? evidence.load.realized_status
          : "ok";
        const rawReason = evidence.load.realized_fallback_reason;
        const fallbackReason = rawReason === null || rawReason === undefined
          ? null
          : typeof rawReason === "string" && /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(rawReason)
            ? rawReason
            : "unknown";
        return { status, fallbackReason };
      }

      function renderCustomEvidence(run) {
        const evidence = loadEvidenceFor(run);
        if (evidence === null) return false;
        const selected = candidateScoreByName(evidence.candidateScores, evidence.load.model_name);
        const baseline = candidateScoreByName(evidence.candidateScores, "WeeklyNaive");

        text(root.querySelector("#performance-zone-subtitle"), "本次任务使用留出周即时回测；近 7 日汇总在后续任务评估后更新");

        text(root.querySelector(".load-mae-note"), selectedMae === null ? "当前有效周尚未形成可评分留出周" : "选定负载模型的留出周 MAE");
        text(root.querySelector(".load-mape-note"), selectedMape === null ? "当前有效周尚未形成可评分留出周" : "选定负载模型的留出周 MAPE");

        const degradedReconstructedWeek = evidence.load.selection_status === "degraded"
          && evidence.load.selection_reason === "latest_week_high_imputation"

        root.querySelectorAll(".candidate").forEach((candidate) => {

                ? `MAE ${metric(nonnegativeMetric(score.mae))}`
                : `WAPE ${percentMetric(score.wape_percent)}`,
            );
          }
        });
        return true;
      }

      function renderCustomPerformance(performance) {
        const load = performance.series[0];

        if (socPerformanceValue !== null) socPerformanceValue.dataset.state = socPending ? "pending" : "ready";
        if (socPending && socPerformanceValue !== null) text(socPerformanceValue, "待实际值完整回填");
        text(root.querySelector("#performance-zone-subtitle"), loadPending && socPending ? "近 7 日暂无同配置可比任务" : "历史任务保留近 7 日 MAPE 汇总；留出周 WAPE 仅用于 weekly_load_v1");
        text(root.querySelector(".acceptance-summary"), loadPending ? "0 个任务" : `${load.run_count} 个任务`);
        setComparisonBars(load.mape_percent, load.baseline_mape_percent);
      }

      function renderCustomResult(value) {
        const { stationKey, result, performance } = value;
        const run = result.run;
        const evidence = loadEvidenceFor(run);
        assert(evidence !== null, "custom run policy invalid");
        const loadResult = result.series.find((series) => series.unique_id === "station_total_load");
        const loadPresentation = realizedLoadPresentation(evidence, loadResult?.model_name ?? null);
        const actualTimes = result.series.flatMap((series) => series.points.filter((point) => point.actual_quality === "valid").map((point) => point.target_time));
        const actualLatest = actualTimes.length ? actualTimes.reduce((left, right) => milliseconds(left) > milliseconds(right) ? left : right) : null;
        const station = {
          station_key: stationKey,
          station_name: STATION_NAMES[STATION_KEYS.indexOf(stationKey)],
          system: { state: loadPresentation.status === "degraded" ? "degraded" : "ready", mode: "normal", generated_at: run.updated_at, stale: false },
          range: {
            timezone: "Asia/Shanghai", history_start: run.forecast_start, history_end: run.forecast_start,
            actual_latest: actualLatest, forecast_start: run.forecast_start, forecast_end: run.forecast_end,
            interval_seconds: run.interval_seconds, history_hours: 0, forecast_hours: run.forecast_days * 24,
            display_hours: run.forecast_days * 24, now_separator: actualLatest || run.forecast_start,
          },
          readiness: customReadinessFor(run),
          series: result.series.map((series) => ({
            unique_id: series.unique_id,
            unit: series.unit,
            model_name: series.model_name,
            status: series.unique_id === "station_total_load" ? loadPresentation.status : "ok",
            fallback_reason: series.unique_id === "station_total_load" ? loadPresentation.fallbackReason : null,
            actual: series.points.map((point) => ({ data_time: point.target_time, value: point.actual_value, quality: point.actual_quality || "invalid", source_revision: 0 })),
            forecast: series.points.map((point, index) => ({ data_time: index === 0 ? run.forecast_start : series.points[index - 1].target_time, target_time: point.target_time, value: point.forecast_value, raw_value: point.forecast_value, is_clipped: false })),
          })),
          acceptance: null,
        };
        renderStation(station, true);
        const section = root.querySelector(".station-section");
        const modelSummary = result.series.map((series) =>
          `${SERIES_LABELS[series.unique_id]}：${displayModelName(series.unique_id, series.model_name)}`
        ).join(" · ");
        root.querySelectorAll(".current-model-name").forEach((node) => text(node, modelSummary));
        text(section.querySelector(".history-window"), `${dateTime(run.history_start)} — ${dateTime(run.history_end)}`);
        text(section.querySelector(".station-status"), CUSTOM_RUN_LABELS[run.status]);
        text(root.querySelector("#result-model-meta"), evidence.usableWeeks !== null
          ? `${evidence.usableWeeks} 个连续有效周 · 负载周期 7 天 · ${intervalLabel(run.interval_seconds)}粒度`
          : `${run.history_days} 天训练 · ${intervalLabel(run.interval_seconds)}粒度`);
        renderCustomPerformance(performance);
        renderCustomEvidence(run);
        errorState.hidden = true;
      }

      function renderError(message = "预测数据暂不可用") {
        hasRenderedDashboard = false;
        lastDashboard = null;
        root.dataset.state = "error";
        text(root.querySelector("#system-state"), "错误");
        text(root.querySelector("#healthy-count"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector("#station-count"), "—");
        text(root.querySelector("#generated-at"), "最近更新：—");
        text(errorState, message);
        errorState.hidden = false;
        root.querySelectorAll(".station-section").forEach(clearSection);
      }

      function renderRefreshError(message) {
        if (!hasRenderedDashboard) {
          renderError(message);
          return;
        }
        text(errorState, message);
        errorState.hidden = false;
      }

      function renderDashboard(value, preserveLastGood = false) {
        try {
          const dashboard = validateDashboard(value);
          root.dataset.state = dashboard.system.state;
          errorState.hidden = true;
          text(root.querySelector("#system-state"), STATE_LABELS[dashboard.system.state]);
          text(root.querySelector("#healthy-count"), String(dashboard.system.healthy_station_count));
          text(root.querySelector("#station-count"), String(dashboard.system.station_count));
          text(root.querySelector("#generated-at"), `最近更新：${dateTime(dashboard.system.generated_at)}`);
          lastDashboard = dashboard;
          initializeTaskDates(dashboard.system.generated_at);
          selectStation(stationPicker.value);
          hasRenderedDashboard = true;
          return true;
        } catch (_error) {
          if (preserveLastGood) renderRefreshError("预测数据加载失败");
          else renderError();
          return false;
        }
      }

      async function loadDashboard() {
        if (authMode === "postmessage" && apiToken === null) {
          renderRefreshError("登录凭证不可用");
          return;
        }
        if (inFlight) return inFlight;
        const requestToken = apiToken;
        const requestHeaders = { Accept: "application/json" };
        if (authMode === "postmessage") requestHeaders.Authorization = `Bearer ${requestToken}`;
        inFlight = (async () => {
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10_000);
          try {
            const response = await fetch(API_PATH, {
              method: "GET",
              cache: "no-store",
              redirect: "error",
              referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
              credentials: "omit",
              headers: requestHeaders,
              signal: controller.signal,
            });
            if (response.status === 401 && authMode === "postmessage") {
              requestAuthentication();
              const authError = new Error("current-user authentication expired");
              authError.name = "M3AuthError";
              throw authError;
            }
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("dashboard request failed");
            const envelope = await response.json();
            scanShape(envelope);
            exactObject(envelope, ["status", "data"], "response envelope");
            assert(envelope.status === "ok", "response status invalid");
            renderDashboard(envelope.data, true);
          } finally {
            window.clearTimeout(timeout);
          }
        })().catch((error) => renderRefreshError(
          error && error.name === "AbortError"
            ? "请求超时"
            : error && error.name === "M3AuthError"
              ? "登录状态已失效"
              : "预测数据加载失败",
        )).finally(() => { inFlight = null; });
        return inFlight;
      }

      function startRefreshTimer() {
        if (refreshTimer !== null) return;
        refreshTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
          if (document.visibilityState === "visible") void loadDashboard();
        }, 60_000);
      }

      function requestAuthentication() {
        if (disposed || authMode !== "postmessage" || parentOrigin === null) return;
        apiToken = null;
        updateTaskConfiguration();
        authNonce = newAuthNonce();
        if (authTimeout !== null) window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
        const requestedNonce = authNonce;
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: "vifa-m3-auth-ready", nonce: requestedNonce }, parentOrigin);
        authTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (authNonce !== requestedNonce) return;
          authNonce = null;
          authTimeout = null;
          renderRefreshError("登录凭证不可用");
        }, 10_000);
      }

      function receiveAuthentication(event) {
        if (disposed || authMode !== "postmessage" || parentOrigin === null) return;
        if (event.source !== window.parent || event.origin !== parentOrigin) return;
        if (!exactAuthMessage(event.data, ["type", "nonce", "token"])) return;
        if (event.data.type !== "vifa-m3-auth-token" || event.data.nonce !== authNonce) return;
        if (!validApiToken(event.data.token)) return;
        apiToken = event.data.token;
        authNonce = null;
        if (authTimeout !== null) {
          window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
          authTimeout = null;
        }
        updateTaskConfiguration();
        startRefreshTimer();
        void loadDashboard();
      }

      window.renderDashboard = renderDashboard;
      window.renderError = renderError;
      window.loadDashboard = loadDashboard;
      window.addEventListener("message", receiveAuthentication);
      window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
        disposed = true;
        apiToken = null;
        authNonce = null;
        if (authTimeout !== null) window.clearTimeout(authTimeout);
        if (refreshTimer !== null) window.clearInterval(refreshTimer);
        stopCustomPolling();
        themeToggle.removeEventListener("click", toggleTheme);
        stationPicker.removeEventListener("change", changeStation);
        detailsToggle.removeEventListener("click", toggleDetails);
        runButton.removeEventListener("click", startCustomForecast);
        [historyStart, historyEnd, forecastDays, granularity].forEach((control) => control.removeEventListener("change", updateTaskConfiguration));
        window.removeEventListener("message", receiveAuthentication);
      }, { once: true });
      if (parentOrigin === null || authMode === null) renderError("页面配置不可用");
      else if (authMode === "server_token") {
        startRefreshTimer();
        void loadDashboard();
      } else requestAuthentication();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
